verdict.rationale: Formant is a robotics fleet operations platform, so hardware bring-up is a fair question for it. However, the evidence never describes a hardware-abstraction layer or stable sensor/actuator interfaces that let engineers swap hardware without rewriting application code. The closest claims are uniform data ingestion across robot types and agent/SDK telemetry and command APIs, which are fleet-level data normalization rather than an on-robot hardware abstraction.
